title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Declared Value Share of the Affected Packages
content:
Where a tier of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` measures liability by declared value, the line never pays more than the part of the declared value that belongs to the packages affected.

## Definition

The **declared value share** is the cover's insured value multiplied by the number of affected packages and divided by the number of packages the cover takes, rounded to the cent. Under the declared value yardstick the settlement is the proven loss, but it never exceeds the declared value share.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical figures)

| Insured value of the cover (USD) | Packages on the cover | Affected packages | Declared value share (USD) | Proven loss (USD) | Settlement before any aggregate (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60000.00 | 500 | 40 | 4800.00 | 5300.00 | 4800.00 |
| 60000.00 | 500 | 40 | 4800.00 | 3900.00 | 3900.00 |
| 25000.00 | 3 | 1 | 8333.33 | 9000.00 | 8333.33 |

In the last row, 25000.00 multiplied by 1 and divided by 3 is 8333.333, which rounds to 8333.33.
